subject: general
question: Two transversal lines S and T cut a set of distinct parallel lines. S cuts the parallel lines in points A, B, C and D and T cuts the parallel lines in points E, F, G and H. If AB = 5 cm, CD = 3 cm and EF = 15 cm, then the length (in cm) of GH is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **Intercept Theorem** states that parallel lines cut any two transversals in the same **ratio**.

Ratio of segments on transversal **S** = Ratio of segments on transversal **T**

AB ÷ CD = EF ÷ GH

5 ÷ 3 = 15 ÷ GH

GH = (3 × 15) ÷ 5 = 9 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 9 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of segment **AB = 5 cm**

Length of segment **CD = 3 cm**

Length of segment **EF = 15 cm**

**Formula Used:**

According to the **Intercept Theorem** (or **Thales Theorem** for parallel lines), if three or more parallel lines intersect two transversals, then they cut off the transversals **proportionally**.

AB ÷ EF = BC ÷ FG = CD ÷ GH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b512c6990fabfb240542d90e619ca866291d3c7d177f28b80f88b4aeef8886cc.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ AB ÷ EF = CD ÷ GH

⇒ 5 ÷ 15 = 3 ÷ GH

⇒ 1 ÷ 3 = 3 ÷ GH

⇒ GH = 3 × 3

⇒ GH = 9 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 9 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Intercept Theorem

If three or more parallel lines are intersected by two transversals, the segments cut off on one transversal are proportional to the corresponding segments on the other.

Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT)

Also known as Thales Theorem, it states that a line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides in the same ratio.

Parallel Lines and Transversals

The distance between parallel lines remains constant, but the length of the transversal segment increases as the angle of the transversal with the parallel lines decreases.</p
